label: Esse-cause bridge decomposed; the ladder of nothing gives what it does not have
summary: Ranking. For each attribute and naming conjunct of NecessaryClassicalGodRootFromUnderived.derive (result 57213a13) the premises its Lean proof uses were read off the three composed proofs (UnderivedRootPerfection, PerfectRootPositiveIntellectWill, ClassicalGodFromPositiveRoot); each premise was then expanded to the intersection, over its verified derivations, of the leaves of those derivations (strict expansion). Count of the ten steps (simple, perfect, good, one, infinite, immutable, eternal, intellect, will, named God) using each premise: underived individual 10, excluded middle 9, esse-cause bridge cb1cdea9 8, simple priority 86efed1a 5, uniting cause, existing-in-act, grades-to-maximum and maximum-causes-all 4 each, then 3 or fewer. The esse-cause bridge is the most consequential stage-two bridge outside the join (W1's lane). Its only derivation (915ad35a) used four leaves: causes of esse are concrete (82eeeb3c), causes of the esse of actual concreta exist at w (c99f9d23), effect dependence (2068f91c) and dependence-to-grounding (2e248016). Results (all Comparator-verified, zero axioms): (1) every existent at w is concrete (0e02cd69) from the existence-to-act contract 0436de86 and one direction of the CONCRETE_6 calibration of the profile's concrete (2d9807a5); it conditionally refutes the recorded rival 4c9908ba (an existing non-concrete esse cause), with no causal premise. (2) c99f9d23 from the maxim 'nothing gives being that it does not have' (4a5a43a5), the contract and act-to-existence 546975ef. (3) A second derivation of cb1cdea9 from c99f9d23, 0e02cd69 and the two dependence premises. (4) 'A cause of being has being' (4ccb319f) from agency in act (ef068f46, the CausesIn sibling of the q.75 a.2 operation premise) and q.4 a.1 ad 3. (5) Strength orders 376d6a5a => d0fc96b7 => 4ccb319f => 4a5a43a5 and 64498e7e => 4a5a43a5, each strict in Control.Controls. Findings: the refutation of 4c9908ba relocates the Platonist rival; it does not defeat it. Under CONCRETE_6 a separately existing Form or mind-independent set is CONCRETE_6, so 4c9908ba is not the Platonist's thesis; a Platonist or Lewisian must (i) deny the existence-to-act contract, (ii) read concrete other than as CONCRETE_6, or (iii) accept that the Form has esse in re, in which case the bridge counts it as an actual concrete ground and the dispute moves to the downstream uniqueness, identity and simplicity steps. The registered refuting result concludes that every existent is concrete; the last step to the rival's negation is the lake-checked unregistered lemma notSomeEsseCauseNonConcrete. Further: the bridge needs only the bottom rung of the 'nothing gives' ladder, which has an entry without any transfer principle. On the coordinator's priority 376d6a5a: its only consumer other than the strength-order registration is causeOfQualityMoreSuch (924302df), which needs the unrestricted scope (strong_version_needed added); q.4 a.2 preexistence 64498e7e has only the derivation through that premise (6b609ddc), so strict expansion makes 376d6a5a indispensable wherever preexistence or the 'more such' premise is used, although preexistence has its own sourced claim. In the composition 376d6a5a enters only through preexistence (perfection) and STMT-GOD-IS-MAXIMAL-IN-BEING (unity). Meaning forks: read formally (IN_ACT_1), and if CAUSE_2 at a respect r counts a maker as a cause of x's being r (an open bridge of DISAMB-BECOMING-BEING-CAUSE), 376d6a5a meets a counterexample: an artisan causes a shape he has only as art, not formally. Q.4 a.2 (claim AQUINAS-ST-I-Q4-A2-PERFECTION-IN-CAUSE-A) places the perfection in the effective cause either by the same ratio, if univocal, or in a more eminent way, so the formal reading is not the source's; read inclusively (IN_ACT_3) the burden moves to consumers sharing InAct, chiefly STMT-UNLIMITED-POSSESSION-EXCEEDS-LIMITED. Instrumental causes (a chisel) are a substantive objection to the unrestricted scope if CAUSE_2 counts instruments; the principal-power reply (q.62 a.4, De potentia q.3 a.7) is unread. The cause-of-being restriction is not touched by instruments of making, which cause becoming (open bridge of DISAMB-BECOMING-BEING-CAUSE). Repairs: the ground-ancestry definition c86cc1d1 (GroundAncestor, WELL_FOUNDEDNESS_1) was unlinked from c99f9d23 and 2e248016, whose Lean types do not reach it; it made any new argument through them mix WELL_FOUNDEDNESS senses. Failed or rejected approaches: deriving c99f9d23 from 'a cause of being has being' alone fails because InAct is world-independent (control 5: everything in act, only one thing exists); a scoped concreteness statement via preexistence was dropped as redundant once existent concreteness gave the clause without a causal premise; registering 82eeeb3c => scoped concreteness, and 4ccb319f => ef068f46, was rejected (the first would flag the frozen existing route as using a strong version where a weak one suffices; the second would close a support cycle with result (4)). The derivation of c99f9d23 is not a transcription because it composes three premises in sequence (effect's existence to its act of being, the maxim, act to existence), each needed in a checked interpretation (controls 3 to 5); the syntactic detector first flagged the term-mode proof as a single application, and the proof was written out step by step for the detector, without changing the chain. CausesIn at esse is read for extrinsic (efficient) causes; DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION does not state this, and prime matter as a material cause of the composite's being is an unread lead against agency in act, 4ccb319f and the maxim. No independent warrant is recorded for the maxim, the calibration or agency in act. Plotinian lead: next test, read Enneads V.2.1 and check whether beyond being fails even the inclusive InAct. No premise is established.
blocker: Remaining leaves of the esse-cause bridge: effect dependence 2068f91c and dependence-to-grounding 2e248016 (with c99f9d23's new inputs 4a5a43a5 and 546975ef, and the calibration 2d9807a5). Next tests: (1) a derivation of q.4 a.2 preexistence that avoids 376d6a5a, e.g. from unrestricted transfer f8ba2429 and a cause-of-being restriction d0fc96b7 grounded without preexistence; (2) a principal-cause sibling of 376d6a5a and a principal-cause restatement of causeOfQualityMoreSuch; (3) read q.62 a.4 / De potentia q.3 a.7 for the instrument reply; (4) warrant for act-to-existence 546975ef, the actualist reading of esse at the reading world.
